info.title: x402api Public API
info.description: Public External-Wallet x402 integration endpoints for programmatic charges, readiness, receiving addresses, resources, payments, receipts, and facilitator discovery.

tags.name: Programmatic charges
tags.description: Idempotent variable-price charges with immutable x402 payment terms.

tags.name: Idempotency
tags.description: Authoritative outcomes for durable public mutation keys.

tags.name: Receiving addresses
tags.description: External receiving-address proof, registration, activation, and rotation.

tags.name: Resources and pricing
tags.description: Protected resources, immutable versions, and network-fee previews.

tags.name: Orders and payments
tags.description: Orders, payments, chain observations, and signed receipt verification.

tags.name: Facilitator discovery
tags.description: Unauthenticated discovery of currently approved x402 profiles.

post.description: Create one idempotent dynamic charge from an active resource template. The immutable challenge freezes exact requested atomic amounts, eligible rails, verified tenant receiving addresses, fee policy and evidence, metadata, and expiry. The caller cannot supply a recipient address.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique mutation key; replaying different content returns HTTP 409.

get.description: Return the tenant-scoped frozen charge terms and current projected status without recomputing prices, recipients, rails, or fee evidence.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from X-X402API-Next-Cursor or rel=next Link.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results in the bounded array page (default and maximum 100).
